verdict.rationale: HubSpot's Marketing Emails API lets an agent list emails, get each one, and query post-send statistics, which covers the campaign-results part of the story. An official MCP server is also documented as an agent entry point. The evidence never shows programmatic access to audiences (segments and lists appear only as UI settings) or to live automations and workflows, so the agent can retrieve only part of the email program. Missing for 10: API access to audiences and segments, API access to live automations and workflows, details of the MCP server's scope, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my whole email program — audiences, live automations, recent campaign results — programmatically and report on what's working

citations.quote: You can also query details about the post-send statistics of a specific email or set of emails.
To retrieve a list of all emails, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails`, and include any filters as query parameters in your request
